description: Substance identity lookup (FDA UNII / GSRS) — Resolves a drug, ingredient or chemical to its FDA UNII identity record from the Global Substance Registration System: preferred name, substance class, molecular formula and weight, stereochemistry, SMILES, official and brand names, synonyms, cross-reference codes (CAS, RxCUI, PubChem, DrugBank, ChEBI, ChEMBL, MeSH, NCI, EPA CompTox, WHO-ATC), active moiety and related salts, metabolites and impurities. Look up by exact name=, unii=, cas= or any listed code=. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

name.description: exact substance name, e.g. ibuprofen or acetylsalicylic acid (or use unii=, cas= or code= instead)
